name: Angelus
quote: O arrow of judgment, purge all that is evil.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. You slept very late last night. While I'm not sure what you were busy with, please take better care of your body, for the Oasis' sake.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Don't be so nervous. I'm just getting close to you to record my observations and definitely not to tease you.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: It's time I checked in with the Pantheon. But before that, I'm quite curious about the "din-ner" those agents were mentioning. Could you bring me over to take a look, Professor?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: It's time to sleep. Your hopes, ambitions and aims can all be found in your dreams. Sweet dreams, Professor.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: From my current observations, your desire to protect the Dolls is not a lie. In that case, I shall provide you with help, provided it does not violate my ethics and faith.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Oh, the incident when we first met? I've already forgotten how rude you were to me back then. Erm... or at least, it doesn't matter anymore.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor? Ah, you're asleep... It's not often that I get to see your sleeping face, so unguarded and vulnerable. I need to record this.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: I'd like to go for a walk around the Oasis. Care to join me, Professor? Tell me its stories, or perhaps your stories.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Professor, have you ever wondered what being shot by an arrow feels like?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Mhm~ What a naughty child you are.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: You need to focus more, Professor.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Understood. I shall do my best.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I am the Sanctifier Angelus, here to work with you in fulfilment of our pact. I'll be in your care now, Professor.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Oh my, is it really good to focus so much on me?

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Oh my. That was unexpected.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: You have placed great trust in me. In that case, I must repay it appropriately.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: This is also part of our cooperation.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Now behold the might of the Sanctifiers.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Judgement comes!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: This victory was only to be expected.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: My arrows shall strike down the wicked.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Did my arrows... fly astray...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Hm? Is this an oath request? Professor, please choose wisely. Did you truly consider what it means to pick me? Honestly, there's no way I can say no when you look at me like that.
...I'd thought of a day like this before, a day when I would not have to worry about my status or the gaze of others, standing by your side for no reason beyond the fact that you asked me to be there. Thank you for choosing me, Professor. From this day forth, my body, heart, and bow will shine for you and you alone.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text:
Happy New Year, Professor. Is this how the Oasis celebrates the new year? Goodness, it's noisier than I expected. Please don't forget that we will be working together this year, in keeping with the Sanctifiers... Hm? Were those fireworks just now? How pretty...
Ahem, it's not like it's my first time seeing fireworks, it's just that the Pantheon wasn't as bustling as this place. Hehe, it seems the idea of a Sanctifier celebrating the new year with you is surprisingly harmonious~

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Professor, this is your chocolate. Sweets made with the Reverse Tower's cooking techniques might taste a little different from the Oasis' confections, but you can consider it a novel experience. Trying different flavors from time to time has a charm of its own.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: For Sanctifiers, parting implies being reset, and when we meet again, it will be a totally different "me" that you see. But since I have inherited Lord Hesperus' will and made a promise with you, I shall stay here and not go anywhere.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Professor, why are you stopping me from cleansing these Daemons... Hm? A costume parade? Halloween? Goodness, to think the Oasis would spend operands on such things. Well, since today is a special occasion, I shall not inquire further. However, I won't go easy on the next person who shows up dressed as a Daemon.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Merry Christmas, Professor. Oh, don't look at me like that just because I'm dressed in this festive attire. As the saying goes, when in Rome, do as the Romans do. Naturally, I have gifts in order to help build better relations between the Sanctifiers and the Oasis. Your gift is a little special... I made it myself. Do you like it?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. What, feeling surprised? We Sanctifiers have no concept of birthdays, but they're important for humans, are they not? Then as you wish, I shall bestow upon you the blessing of the Sanctifiers; may you live long in peace and ease.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Professor, I came to the Oasis both to work with you and monitor the situation here. Rather than have you agonize over my intentions, I would rather lay everything on the table and bring it into the open as part of our negotiations. Hehehe, well yes, I do have my own plans for doing so. In any case, I'll be in your care for the foreseeable future, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: I must apologize for calling you a Daemon during our previous encounter. While I cannot acknowledge your position, you HAVE made great contributions to the stability of Magrasea... Hehehe, I'm not saying this to praise you, of course; I still remember all the times you overstepped your boundaries and acted rashly. In any case, please do not forget that we're working together, so be good, okay~

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
You wish to know more about the Pantheon? No can do, surveillance and questioning is my privilege and all attempts to overstep your bounds will result in severe punishment from the Reverse Tower...
Hehe, that was a joke~ However, I have not been authorized to reveal that information to you in its entirety. Rather than obtain partial knowledge from me, why not go there and find out for yourself? That would be the wise approach that suits you, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
You want me to enjoy more of the Oasis' recreational activities? By myself? (Sigh) Professor, have you forgotten that my job is to establish a relationship with the Oasis and monitor you? Do you think I'm the kind of Sanctifier who would abandon her tasks and run off to have fun? Or are you saying you wish to escape my oversight?
Hehehe... At the very least, you should invite me to enjoy this evening banquet. That would be more appropriate, don't you think? The watcher and the watched move together, further improving their cooperation within a permissible boundary.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
When we met in the Enigma Sector, I saw you as a Daemon and viewed you and all the Oasis as enemies. After being beaten, I ought to have martyred myself for my faith, but you did not strike the killing blow. Instead, you let me leave. I could not understand why you did that... At least, at the time.
Once, doubt and confusion plagued my bow, but after experiencing many things, I learned to contemplate and I have judged the Sanctifiers and the Oasis anew. As for the relationship between you and I, I am still working hard to figure it out and find the answer. Until I do, will you allow me to stay by your side? This is a request from both the Sanctifiers and from me.

career:
The H01-PX05(R) is a Greater Sanctifier of the Reverse Babylon Tower, codenamed "Angelus". As a key member of the Magrasea Super Cloud Servers Comprehensive Security System, the H01-PX05(R) combines parts of the neural cloud data from previous generations of Sanctifiers and boasts the most powerful individual beyond-visual-range combat capabilities of any Sanctifier currently in service. In addition to potent combat capabilities, Angelus can efficiently communicate with agents from various sectors during the course of her duties, ensuring good relations with said sectors. Once she recognizes the threat level of what she is facing, she can rapidly shift to combat mode and quickly destroy any latent or extant threats.

Due to the impending mass Entropization of Magrasea, Angelus is currently working with the Oasis on behalf of the Sanctifiers, and both parties have achieved excellent collaborative results against the Entropics and turncoat Sanctifiers. In addition, Angelus has expressed a desire to deepen her cooperation with the Oasis and the Professor thanks to a personal interest in both.
infoStories:
The initial design of the Sanctifiers and indeed, the entire Reverse Babylon Tower came from Jamila, a 42Lab network security expert. After designing the H01-PX01 and H01-PX02 agents, who were intended for coordination and leadership tasks, as well as the H01-PX01(I) who would be responsible for support duties, they began focusing on the Greater Sanctifiers, whose primary focus would be eliminating viruses. Jamila designed several prototypes which focused on various aspects such as prevention, detection, elimination, restoration, self-examination and so on, then recorded them into the Pantheon. Depending on the needs of the cloud, the Pantheon would spawn an appropriate Greater Sanctifier with a mix of capabilities appropriate to the situation.

Meanwhile, Angelus is the Sanctifier that was created after combining neural cloud data from certain predecessor generations of Sanctifiers and undergoing an iterative generation process that focuses on detecting and precisely eliminating viruses. Her outstanding detection algorithms allow her to precisely lock onto viruses and eliminate them from well beyond their detection radius.

After taking into consideration the fact that even Greater Sanctifiers might end up taking damage or be lost in the process of defending the cloud, the Pantheon's systems were preloaded with large quantities of Greater Sanctifier data images. When there was a lack of Greater Sanctifiers, the Pantheon would generate a new Greater Sanctifier image, based on their data and functions. There was no practical benefit for an antivirus software suite to possess such functionality. While Jamila insisted that it would facilitate visual management of the system, others felt that it was simply a way for her to satisfy her idiosyncrasies.

That said, Angelus' appearance data contained a lot of information which had been tampered with, which greatly affected her generation process. In fact, certain Sanctifiers commented that she greatly resembled a Sanctifier from a previous generation—Electra. Since the cloud's disconnection from reality, there was no way for the outside world to affect the Sanctifiers' program settings. The only possibility was that someone within the Sanctifiers had used their permissions to alter the appearance data.

As Sanctifiers who spawned in the same batch, Angelus and Eucharist had a sisterly relationship. While the two of them had dramatically different personalities and even belonged to different factions, they were often seen together. Eucharist would always harass Angelus, while Angelus would rein Eucharist in whenever she caused troubles. In human terms, the two of them would probably be the kind of siblings who would always bicker around each other, but who would never leave their sister alone.

However, according to Angelus' own testimony, she and Eucharist were never sisters and have never been able to understand each other. Angelus could not understand why Eucharist had defied, even blasphemed against the Sanctifiers' principles. After many conflicts, Angelus chose to distance herself from Eucharist, and after the latter's betrayal, Angelus never managed to successfully save her "sister".

"Perhaps our paths had already diverged from the beginning, and by the time I realized it, it was too late."

Angelus' first encounter with the Oasis was not a happy one. The data of the Exiles who had left the Cloud Sector did not match up to the data in Angelus' screening systems. As such, Angelus fulfilled her duties and engaged the Exiles in battle at the Enigma Sector, attempting to delete the unverified data. However, she was defeated and forced away from her area of jurisdiction.

While she could not fulfil her duties, the fact her area of jurisdiction was ultimately saved by entities she considered Daemons caused Angelus to develop a great interest in the Oasis. The Oasis had the power to defeat a Greater Sanctifier and also had the ability to handle issues that even a Sanctifier would have trouble resolving, to the point where several Sectors had voluntarily chosen to leave the Sanctifiers' protection and deploy Sandbox Barriers. Every such report received caused dread among the Greater Sanctifiers, and in order to both keep an eye on the Oasis and verify its stance on the matter, Angelus was planning to open negotiations with the Oasis. However, before she could put her plan into action, the Reverse Tower was suborned and Entropized by Eosphorus, which resulted in Angelus not being able to travel to the Oasis.

Angelus began officially working with the Oasis during the battle against Eosphorus. Though their time together was short, she managed to earn the trust of the Professor and the Oasis' Dolls. As part of the next generation of the cloud's defenders, Angelus came to the Oasis to forge a closer relationship with them. Unlike her usual stern and unyielding demeanor, Angelus soon found herself lost in exploring the Oasis, particularly the various desserts that Eos introduced to her. However, she constantly emphasized that she was doing so in order observe and monitor the Oasis, probably to salvage her dignity as a Sanctifier.

Thanks to Angelus' hard work, a breakthrough was finally made in the already-relaxed relationship between the Sanctifiers and the Oasis, and the two sides could march toward the future together. Their ties grew closer, and they collectively built a new cloud security framework. That said, Magrasea-wide drone livestreams, testing weird drugs of uncertain provenance and other such actions are still banned by the Sanctifiers.

"Speaking of which, Angelus seems very insistent that she's going to monitor the Professor. Don't tell me... Persicaria?! Hey, Persicaria, where are you going?!"
- Oasis HR Department Audio Log
